name: Inner Monologue
summary: Inner Monologue closes the loop around LLM planning by injecting textual feedback into the prompt: whether the last skill succeeded, what objects are currently visible, and what a human just said. The model then continues its chain of reasoning and revises the plan, producing retry behavior and adaptation to interruptions that open-loop planners cannot express.
innovation: Textual feedback as the universal interface between perception, humans and the planner.
Emergent replanning and retrying from prompting alone, with no additional training.
matters: Established closed-loop LLM planning, the pattern later internalized by Hi Robot and pi-0.5.
limits: Depends on reliable success detection, which remains an unsolved problem in itself.
lineage: SayCan made closed-loop by returning execution feedback to the language model.
